note: Rank 1 is best. Two methods are separable only if their mean ranks differ by more than the critical difference. With few blocks the CD is wide, which is a property of the design, not a failure.
caveat: One block per corpus. With three blocks the Nemenyi critical difference is very wide; treat non-separation as low power, not as evidence of equivalence. LightGCN and SASRec received smaller tuning budgets and are contextual references.
